subject: MSA / Order Form kickoff — party details, template variant, and redline priorities
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@stratohealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: MSA / Order Form kickoff — party details, template variant, and redline priorities

Hi Emma —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. As we start the contracting loop for the StratoHealth engagement, a few items to help us scope the first-pass redline: 

1) Party details & signatory authority: can you confirm the legal entity name, headquarters address, and the person authorized to sign (name, title, email)? We attached a lightweight party sheet to populate.

2) Template preference: attached is our standard Redwood_MSA_v2.docx and a draft Order Form (OrderForm_Draft_STRATO.xlsx). If you have a preferred company template, please share. If you plan to use ours, indicate any high-level must-haves so we can prioritize.

3) Likely redline hotspots we expect from customers of your size (please flag any that are critical for you): data residency (EU/US carveouts), SLA and MTTR commitments, liability cap, indemnity carveouts, and breach notification timelines. If data residency is a hard requirement, call it out now so we can route to Legal early.

4) Timeline: our suggested cadence is 48–72 hour turn on first redline from Redwood once we have signatory and billing contacts. Are you targeting a particular go-live or procurement window?

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v2.docx (MS Word), OrderForm_Draft_STRATO.xlsx (Excel), Strato_Party_Sheet.xlsx (Excel)

If you prefer a short kickoff call (15m) with contracts + commercial, happy to set one up early next week — otherwise we can exchange the party sheet + initial notes in email.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Contracts Operations
Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0121
From: Emma Lawson <emma.lawson@stratohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: StratoHealth Legal <legal@stratohealth.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA / Order Form kickoff — party details, template variant, and redline priorities

Hi Irene —

Appreciate the clear list. Weve attached our completed party sheet and the internal procurement intake for your team. Quick answers below:

- Legal entity: StratoHealth, Inc. (CA)
- HQ: 1024 Harbor Way, San Mateo, CA 94401
- Signing authority: Emma Lawson, VP, Procurement — emma.lawson@stratohealth.com (I will confirm CFO backup if needed)

Template: We generally prefer to start from counterparty template only if there are significant deviations. Would you prefer we put our MSA on the table or accept Redwoods with redlines? We can do either, but given timelines were open to your MSA with a few requested changes (outlined below).

Top priorities (StratoHealth):
- Data residency: certain PHI-adjacent datasets must remain within US regions — we will flag sections for carveouts.
- SLA: request a 99.9% uptime objective for core inference APIs and defined credits for sustained outages.
- Liability: wed like to discuss a per-claim cap that reflects expected damages for our use case (well propose language).

Attaching: Strato_Party_Sheet.xlsx (completed), Strato_Procurement_Intake.pdf, and a brief note from Legal that well send formal redlines within 72 hours.

If helpful, lets do a 20m touch on Monday 10am PT with technical + procurement to confirm SLA metrics.

Best,
Emma Lawson
VP, Procurement
StratoHealth
emma.lawson@stratohealth.com
(650) 555-4433
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MSA / Order Form kickoff — party details, template variant, and redline priorities

Irene / Marissa —

Thanks Emma for the party sheet — good to have the signing authority on file. Quick internal take before we respond:

- Prioritization proposal: we should triage redlines into three buckets so Commercial can maintain momentum:
  A) Must-resolve prior to countersign (data residency, signing authority, essential SLA credit)
  B) Negotiable during commercial review (liability cap levels, indemnity scope clarifications)
  C) Operational items to bake into SOWs/exhibits (onboarding timelines, support contact SLA specifics)

- Suggested owners: Jonas to handle legal redlines (indemnity/liability/data residency carveouts), Marissa to own commercial/billing and exhibit-level responsibilities, Contracts Ops (Irene) to coordinate tracker and signatory confirmations.

- Proposed timing: we can turn a marked-up MSA (Redwood_MSA_v2) with comments back to StratoHealth within 48 hours of Legal receiving the party sheet. If they instead provide their template, well scope the variance review and push a comparable turnaround.

Ive sketched a one-page redline-priority-plan and attached it.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Director, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Subject: Fwd: MSA / Order Form kickoff — assignment and next steps

Kim / Marissa / Jonas —

Forwarding Emmas party sheet and procurement note. Per Kims plan, please take the following action items so we keep to a tight first-turn: 

- Jonas: please take lead on MSA redline for indemnity / liability / data residency carveouts. Target: first-pass tracked MSA back to Emma by Wed 11 Jun EOD (48 hours).
- Marissa: please prepare a commercial note on proposed billing cadence and any non-standard billing exhibits; confirm billing contact listed (we have procurement + a separate AP contact).
- Kim: coordinate with Jonas on what we can accept as standard vs what needs escalation.
- Me: Ill assemble the redline tracker and upload the artifacts to the HubSpot deal (link below) and prepare a short summary for the Monday 10am sync if its confirmed.

Emma — thanks for being responsive. Well proceed with Redwood_MSA_v2 as the starting point and raise counterparty deviations in the first turn; if you prefer to push your template instead, please tell us today and well pivot.

Next steps / Links: 
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890
- Drafts / attachments uploaded to drive after first-pass redline (I will notify).

Attachments: redline-priority-plan.pdf (Contracts Ops)

Best,
Irene
